tools.name: boxing_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming professional boxing cards worldwide, grouped by card: date, start_utc (card start in UTC), venue, promoter, broadcasters, and each bout with both records going in, division, scheduled rounds, title, Boxerbook forecast and market consensus when known. Use this for "who is fighting tonight /

tools.name: boxing_results
tools.description: Completed professional bouts of the last N days (N calendar days ending today: 1 = today, 2 = last night and today, up to 14), newest first: winner, method, round, time, both records going in and the sources of each result. Use this for "who won last night", "results this weekend". Cite the url of e

tools.name: boxer
tools.description: One boxer's card by name, slug or Boxerbook id: country, division, record (W-L-D, KOs), stance, height, reach, birth date, nickname, next fight, last result, Boxerbook rating and, when known, the record as betting favourite and underdog. A name goes through the site search and returns the best match

tools.name: next_fight
tools.description: A boxer's next scheduled bout (by name, slug or id): date, start_utc (card start in UTC), opponent, venue, broadcasters, Boxerbook forecast and market consensus when known; next_fight is null when none is on record (last_result is then the latest bout). Cite the url.

tools.name: bout
tools.description: One bout in full by Boxerbook bout id: both boxers with records going in, status, result (winner, method, round, time), start_utc, venue, card, broadcasters, sources, Boxerbook forecast with its signals and the market consensus when known. Cite the url.

tools.name: where_to_watch
tools.description: The broadcasters (platform, region, link) of a bout or of a whole card, with the card start time in UTC. Give bout_id or event_id. An empty list means none is on record yet. Cite the url.

tools.name: rankings
tools.description: The top 15 of a division: the Boxerbook rating (default) or the latest list of a publisher (WBC, WBA, IBF, WBO, The Ring, TBRB), with records. Division by code (hea, wel, w_fea) or name (heavyweight, women's flyweight). Cite the url.

tools.name: search_boxers
tools.description: Find boxers by name (at most 20), best match first: id, slug, name, country, division, record. Use this when a name is ambiguous or its spelling unsure, then call boxer or next_fight with the id. Cite the url.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the whole catalog with one query: boxers by name, bouts by two surnames ("Inoue vs Nakatani"), their cards, and divisions ("heavyweight rankings"); an id such as bout:123 is looked up directly. Each hit has an id for fetch, a title and its boxerbook.com url; ChatGPT connectors and deep resear

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full document for an id returned by search: a boxer card, a bout (records, result, broadcasters, forecast, market, sources), a card with its bouts, or a division's rankings, as Markdown text with metadata. Pass the id unchanged; an unknown id returns an error. Cite the url.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
